name: Katerina
source:
Katerina – A highly skilled and beautiful swordswoman

She is dignified and resolute, with a strong sense of pride, but occasionally shows endearingly absent-minded traits.
After being saved by the protagonist from a monster attack, she decides to join them.
Clau is the best swordsman in the kingdom, having won a swordsmanship tournament.
However, she suffers from trauma due to a childhood monster attack, causing her legs to tremble when facing monsters.
As the protagonists' combat mentor, she not only trains them but also joins them on their journey.
By becoming the protagonist's familiar, she can wield her sword techniques freely in battle.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250228054440/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.genius.kitsuneisekaicol]Google Play[/url]]
